card.name: Words inside ALL-CAPS warning headings
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS text, mostly boxed-warning headings, such as small linking words (OF, OR, AND, WITH) or the middle of a capitalized medical word. The next word is expected to be another capitalized term.

modes.label: Linking words in caps
modes.description: A small linking word like OF, OR, AND or WITH between capitalized terms in a heading.

modes.label: Inside capitalized medical words
modes.description: A partial word in a capitalized warning title, before the rest of the word or phrase.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it mildly suppresses tokens starting with T, which fits a capitalized word continuing.
card.plain: It marks a word in an all-caps warning heading, usually a small linking word or part of a long word, where more caps text follows.
